headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 release date
title: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 Release Date October 23 | Also on Switch 2 | Gaming News
video_script: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 releases on October twenty third, twenty twenty six, on PS5, Xbox Series X and S, PC and Nintendo Switch 2. Call of Duty is coming back to Nintendo, and Switch 2 gets a native version, not a cloud one. Note that it is not coming to PS4 or Xbox One. Cross-play and cross-progression are supported. Will you be playing? Comment below!

scenes.sub: PS5 | Xbox Series X|S | PC | Switch 2

description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 releases October 23, 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC and Nintendo Switch 2 (native). Not on PS4/Xbox One.
